title: Retract a priming example
description:
As an application, I want to withdraw a priming example I added, so that a withdrawn human review stops reaching prompts and learning while the retraction stays auditable.

Feature: Retract a priming example
  Scenario: Retracting removes the example from prompts
    Given a store with an added priming example
    When the application retracts it
    Then the next decision request carries no such example and the retraction records who and when
